analyzed_vuln.description: `zfp_getcell` dereferences `context->schunk` (`context->schunk->blockshape`, `nmetalayers`, etc.) without validating that `context->schunk` is non-NULL/initialized in this decompression path. In the frame/getitem-driven path, this pointer can be invalid, leading to a wild read and SEGV at line 737 before any safe fallback/metadata parsing can occur.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: A crafted frame processed by `decompress_frame_fuzzer` reaches `frame_decompress_chunk -> get_coffset -> blosc2_getitem -> _blosc_getitem -> blosc_d`, enters the UDCODEC/ZFP fixed-rate branch (`context->compcode == BLOSC_CODEC_ZFP_FIXED_RATE` and `thread_context->zfp_cell_nitems > 0`), and calls `zfp_getcell` on attacker-controlled chunk data while `context->schunk` is not valid for this context. Because `zfp_getcell` assumes a valid schunk and immediately dereferences it, malformed input can trigger the null/wild-pointer read crash.
